# The Best of Dao

Author:
Dr. Supakorn Buasai

Description

A bilingual (Thai–English) educational resource
introducing Daoist philosophy.

Topics

• Laozi
• Zhuangzi
• Dao De Jing
• Wu Wei
• Leadership
• Simplicity
• Chinese philosophy
